summary: The relaxed RFC3339 parser slices the timezone suffix at byte 3 while checking for UTC, panicking when that index splits a UTF-8 character. The fix compares bytes instead, allowing malformed suffixes to return a parse error. The fix adds an assertion to test_datetime_from_str that rejects "2015-02-18T23:16:9.15øøø"; reversing the implementation line should make this assertion panic during parsing. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: byte index 3 is not a char boundary
